description: Scrape TikTok music/sound metadata and the videos that use a particular sound. Provide music page URLs or bare numeric IDs.

includeMusicMetadata.description: Emit a metadata row for each music/sound with title, author, duration, cover images, DSP links, and video count.
includeMusicMetadata.title: Include Music Metadata

includePosts.description: Emit post rows for videos that use each sound. Posts include full video metadata, author info, and engagement stats.
includePosts.title: Include Posts Using This Sound

maxPostsPerSound.description: Maximum number of video posts to scrape per music/sound. Set to 0 to skip post scraping (equivalent to includePosts: false).
maxPostsPerSound.title: Max Posts Per Sound

musicIds.description: Numeric TikTok music/sound IDs as strings (15–20 digits). Alternative to providing full URLs.
musicIds.title: Music IDs

title: TikTok Music/Sound Scraper Input
